findings: Retail collision queries are direction-sensitive and one-sided at the polygon-plane test.
0x1CAA8 and 0x1CE70 execute an explicit dot(direction,normal) < 0 gate before intersection.
Godot ConcavePolygonShape3D with backface_collision=true is therefore not semantically equivalent to the retail query path.
Projection class byte 0/1/2 selects which two coordinates are used for projected inside-polygon testing.
This closes the previous uncertainty over one-sided versus blanket two-sided collision for these query paths.
godot_implication: Retail collider prototype must preserve source triangle winding and use one-sided collision semantics; blanket backface_collision=true is FALSIFIED_AS_SOURCE_SEMANTICS.
